scoring_justification: Recompute from raw PDOS is infeasible because the verifier only sees extracted CSV values; result-level comparison against paper gold within tolerance and a strict monotonic trend check provide a strong verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference DOS values for Ca(Al0.5Si0.5)2 and total N(EF) values for all six compounds, extracted from the paper's Table I.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I, exact reported numbers.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied from the reference solution solve.sh which faithfully reproduces the paper's table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The numbers are the paper's own published results for the same system; they serve as a hidden gold for tolerance-based comparison and trend validation.

outputs.description: One row per compound containing the site- and orbital-projected density of states at the Fermi level. All values are in states/eV per formula unit.

output_contract.notes: The material system is the six ternary silicides M(A0.5Si0.5)2 (M=Ca,Sr,Ba; A=Al,Ga). The compound column must contain the exact string identifiers as given in the paper (Ca(Al0.5Si0.5)2, Sr(Al0.5Si0.5)2, Ba(Al0.5Si0.5)2, Ca(Ga0.5Si0.5)2, Sr(Ga0.5Si0.5)2, Ba(Ga0.5Si0.5)2).
